item.scenerystaff.scenery_staff.desc.1: §dA staff given form in Denia's name — it unfolds an Erosion Domain that devours all.
item.scenerystaff.scenery_staff.desc.2: §5§o"The scenery is set — time for the curtain to fall."
item.scenerystaff.scenery_staff_worn.des: §7A first draft of the Scenery Staff, pieced together from Xuzhi and a shattered blade blank.
§7It cannot unfold a domain yet — only a thin wave edge, barely enough to guard its bearer.
§7For it to remember its own name, it will need far more echoes.
§8§o"Even a faded scenery deserves to be remembered."
item.scenerystaff.qimingxing.desc.1: §bYou soar through a silent sea of stars — stardust crumbling at your side, time dying away behind you.
item.scenerystaff.qimingxing.desc.2: §bThe endless solitude never vanished; it was only stretched, diluted and reshaped, until it became part of your wings.
item.scenerystaff.qimingxing.desc.3: §bThe universe tests you with silence, and you keep going — answering with a bright radiance. Bon voyage
item.scenerystaff.qimingxing.desc.4: §5§o"I hope I make you proud — I hope I never let you down."
item.scenerystaff.qimingxing_worn.desc.1: §bYou have not taken off yet. The sea of stars spreads overhead, like an unsigned invitation.
item.scenerystaff.qimingxing_worn.desc.2: §bThe blade is light — light as a wish not yet made — but it already points that way.
item.scenerystaff.qimingxing_worn.desc.3: §5§o"Remember this night for now. When day breaks, I will be gone."
item.scenerystaff.hushenfu.desc.1: §dAn amulet of soft lines and lustrous texture, carved with the emblem of the Roya.
item.scenerystaff.hushenfu.desc.2: §dAn amulet of the Roya, once held dear by the child who carried it — and lost.
item.scenerystaff.hushenfu.desc.3: §dNow it has drifted into your hands, proving that none of it was meaningless.
item.scenerystaff.hushenfu.desc.4: §dThe world is quiet and beautiful now, just as you hoped it would be on the road you chose.
item.scenerystaff.hushenfu.desc.5: §5§o"That neither long nor short bond began with it, and ends with it."
item.scenerystaff.xuzhi.desc.1: §dA pink afterglow that condenses where a phantom fades — matter caught between being and nothingness.
item.scenerystaff.xuzhi.desc.2: §dIt carries no frequency of its own, yet it resonates faintly with a SlashBlade's edge.
item.scenerystaff.xuzhi.desc.3: §d"Nothing remains in the soundless zone, yet something always waits to be remembered."
item.scenerystaff.denia_waveband.desc.1: §dA waveband condensed from Xuzhi, holding the lingering frequency of a Resonator named "Denia".
item.scenerystaff.denia_waveband.desc.2: §dIt can be neither copied nor erased — it only trembles when that name is spoken.
item.scenerystaff.denia_waveband.desc.3: §5§o"When the scenery falls, may we meet again in the echo."
§dA waveband condensed from Xuzhi and Aemis's amulet, holding the lingering frequency of a Resonator named "Aemis".
§dIt can be neither copied nor erased — it only trembles when that voyage is remembered.
§5§o"However far I travel, I will bring this frequency home."
item.scenerystaff.denia_birthday_cake.de: §dA birthday cake from the Deep Space Federation — allegedly free of any food-safety concerns whatsoever.
§dOrange flavoured and exquisitely made; at Denia's own request, its surface is piled with strange hard candies and dried fruit...
§5§o"Happy birthday — this time, I'll light the candle."
